# Enhance Health Group

> > Enhance Health Group provides comprehensive mental health and addiction treatment services throughout Orange County, California, specializing in evidence-based therapies like CBT and DBT for individuals, couples, and families.

Based in Orange County, Enhance Health Group offers a wide range of behavioral health services including couples rehab, LGBTQ+ affirming care, eating disorder treatment, and virtual mental health programs. Their approach integrates cognitive behavioral therapy, dialectical behavior therapy, and holistic recovery methods across multiple Southern California communities.
